node.statement: Disposition of ch-a333f25dd492b336 (the obstruction is genuine). For each W in {U,V}, set u_W=Co^{A_R}_{P_W^R}(P_W^R). The permitted outer-compression external gives ||T_W(I_{B_W})-u_W||<=C_out*t, while def-four-corner-merging-datum requires ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R||<=rho. Hence the triangle inequality gives only ||T_W(I_{B_W})-P_W^R||<=C_out*t+||u_W-P_W^R||. The corner-algebra external identifies u_W but gives no comparison with P_W^R; the amplified-compression externals give only amplification/range, idempotence, and dagger identities; and nested-corner comparison estimates Co(Y)-Y only after the unsupported premise Y in S^{A_R}_{P_W^R}. Thus no shard-permitted input bounds the remaining term. Node 1.8 is not a valid qed and the root cannot be proved in this workspace. A sufficient repair is to add a separately validated, shard-permitted universal corner-unit estimate ||Co_P(P)-P||<=K_unit*(delta+epsilon) (with its amplified form). Here delta=C_nest*t and epsilon=2*C_ca*t, so one must take C_cross>=max{1,C_nest,2*C_ca,C_out+K_unit*(C_nest+2*C_ca)} and e_cross no larger than e_unit/(C_nest+2*C_ca), in addition to node 1.1 thresholds. Until that dependency is provisioned, the mathematically correct disposition is to leave node 1 pending rather than assert the four-corner datum.
